items.title: John Pope Interview, 1959-05-01
items.q: "I wish I could have gotten known to him by that time I'd have him here with me."

ctx.x: That's fine. You're telling us everything we want to know about it. It's wonderful to hear it. You know?

Yes. So, as I'm saying now, at the present time, Mr. Eddie Langston, he has the band. I said, he'll get together, you know. Yeah. Yeah, for the carnival. But after I'd given it up, there was a Charlie Lifstein that played with me. He'd taken the band over. Well, it's short-lived, you know. Didn't have it very long. And after he died, this Langston's taking it over.

So there were breaks in the band's history when the band was not playing? How's that? Yes. And then somebody else reformed the band? Is that right? Yes, that's right. Yes, sir. What do you think of the way they play now? Well, I like it very much. What sort of...
